adopt.en: The committee adopted a revised protocol after reviewing the pilot data.
adopt.zh: 委员会审阅试点数据后采纳了修订后的研究方案。

adopt.en: Many universities have adopted open access policies to broaden dissemination of research findings.
adopt.zh: 许多大学已采纳开放获取政策，以扩大研究成果的传播范围。

adopt.en: The couple decided to adopt a child from the public foster care system.
adopt.zh: 这对夫妇决定从公共寄养体系中收养一名儿童。

administer.en: A trained researcher administered the questionnaire to each participant in a private room.
administer.zh: 一名受过专门训练的研究人员在独立房间内向每位受访者发放问卷。

administer.en: The agency administers the national program for student financial aid.
administer.zh: 该机构负责实施全国学生助学项目。

administer.en: The same dose was administered intravenously under close clinical supervision.
administer.zh: 在严密临床监护下以静脉方式给药，剂量与前次相同。

advise.en: The panel advised the ministry to revise the draft regulation before its adoption.
advise.zh: 专家小组建议主管部门在草案通过之前先行修订。

advise.en: Several senior colleagues advised her to seek a second opinion from the specialist.
advise.zh: 几位资深同事建议她向该领域专家再行请教。

advise.en: The supervisor advised the committee of the change in research protocol.
advise.zh: 指导教师就研究方案的变动向委员会作了通报。

affiliate.en: Several departments affiliated themselves with the newly established center for interdisciplinary research.
affiliate.zh: 若干院系挂靠新组建的跨学科研究中心。

affiliate.en: The ministry required private testing centers to affiliate with an accredited national body.
affiliate.zh: 主管部门要求各私营检测机构隶属一家经认证的国家机构。

affiliate.en: Two research teams affiliated their archives with the national library to improve long-term access.
affiliate.zh: 两个研究团队将各自的档案挂靠国家图书馆，以改善长期取用条件。

anticipate.en: Researchers anticipated that the reform would reduce delays in the review of grant proposals.
anticipate.zh: 研究人员预期该项改革将缩短科研基金申请的评审周期。

anticipate.en: We anticipate substantial variation in reading times across the sample of adult learners.
anticipate.zh: 我们预计成年学习者样本在阅读时长上存在显著差异。

anticipate.en: The conference proceedings were released earlier than the organizers had anticipated.
anticipate.zh: 会议文集的发布时间早于组织者的预期。

authenticate.en: The archive employs a cryptographic protocol to authenticate each digital record.
authenticate.zh: 该档案馆采用加密协议对每一份数字记录进行认证。

authenticate.en: The laboratory authenticates the provenance of samples before reporting their isotopic values.
authenticate.zh: 实验室在报告同位素数值之前对样本来源加以鉴别。

authenticate.en: Historians authenticate manuscripts by comparing inks, seals and scribal conventions.
authenticate.zh: 历史学者通过比较墨迹、印章与书写习惯来鉴别手稿真伪。

capture.en: The questionnaire was designed to capture variation in students' prior exposure to academic writing.
capture.zh: 问卷的设计旨在捕捉学生先前学术写作接触程度的差异。

capture.en: The camera captured the onset of the storm as it crossed the valley.
capture.zh: 摄像机记录下风暴越过河谷时的初始景象。

capture.en: The special issue captured a wide range of methodological approaches to the study of bilingualism.
capture.zh: 该专刊广泛汇集了双语研究中多种多样的方法路径。

classify.en: Researchers classify responses according to the level of agreement reported by participants.
classify.zh: 研究者依据受访者所报告的认同程度对作答进行归类。

classify.en: Taxonomists classify organisms by shared morphological traits rather than by superficial resemblance.
classify.zh: 分类学家依据共同的形态特征而非表面相似性对生物加以分类。

classify.en: The commission would classify the country as a high-income economy with rapid growth.
classify.zh: 该委员会将把该国归类为高收入且增长迅速的经济体。

conceive.en: The team conceived the study as a response to recurring gaps in published evidence.
conceive.zh: 该团队将这项研究设想为对已发表证据中反复出现的空白的回应。

conceive.en: It is difficult to conceive of a reform that would satisfy all stakeholders.
conceive.zh: 很难设想出一项能够满足所有利益相关方诉求的改革。

conceive.en: She conceived the framework after reviewing archival records from earlier decades.
conceive.zh: 她在审阅了此前数十年的档案记录之后构想出这一框架。

concur.en: Most reviewers concur that the sampling strategy limits the strength of the conclusions.
concur.zh: 多数评审者一致认为抽样策略限制了结论的效力。

concur.en: The committee concurred with the recommendation of the independent review panel.
concur.zh: 委员会同意独立评审小组提出的建议。

concur.en: Three separate surveys concur in their conclusion that rural schools face persistent shortages.
concur.zh: 三项彼此独立的调查得出相同结论，认为农村学校持续面临资源短缺。

conform.en: The revised protocol must conform to the ethical guidelines issued by the review board.
conform.zh: 修订后的方案必须符合审查委员会发布的伦理准则。

conform.en: The measurement scale conformed closely to the structure proposed in the original theoretical framework.
conform.zh: 该测量量表与原始理论框架所提出的结构高度吻合。

conform.en: Newly hired staff were expected to conform to the department's standards of academic writing.
conform.zh: 新入职的教职人员应当符合该院系对学术写作的规范要求。

consist.en: The final sample consists of graduate students enrolled in several disciplines.
consist.zh: 最终样本由来自若干学科的在校研究生构成。

consist.en: The difficulty of the task consists in the ambiguity of the instructions.
consist.zh: 该任务的难点在于指令表述的含糊性。

consist.en: The committee consists of senior scholars and representatives of the participating institutions.
consist.zh: 委员会由资深学者和各参与机构的代表组成。

convey.en: The abstract should convey the main finding without overstating its significance.
convey.zh: 摘要应当传达主要发现而不得夸大其意义。

convey.en: Nonverbal cues such as tone and posture convey meaning that words alone cannot capture.
convey.zh: 语调与体态等非言语线索传达出单纯依靠言语无法获取的意义。

convey.en: Pipelines convey crude oil from the producing region to coastal refineries.
convey.zh: 管道将原油从产区输送到沿海炼油厂。

cultivate.en: Universities cultivate the reading habits that underpin lifelong academic engagement.
cultivate.zh: 大学培养支撑终身学术投入的阅读习惯。

cultivate.en: She cultivated a disciplined writing routine through regular practice and feedback.
cultivate.zh: 她通过规律练习与反馈养成了一套严谨的写作习惯。

cultivate.en: The region cultivated rice on terraced fields that follow the contour of the valley.
cultivate.zh: 该地区在沿河谷等高线修筑的梯田上种植水稻。
